incidents.description: While crew was running casing, at approximately 5,000 feet in the hole the nosecone assembly to the CRT fell to the rig floor.  Crew members were attempting to set the spider, when they heard a loud noise.  At this time, they visually observed the CRT's nosecone assembly had fallen approximately 20 ft. No injuries occurred, classified as a near miss.

incidents.description: On April 14,2026, at approximately 5:30pm Robert Duggin was working the fill-up hose at the casing stump on Patterson Rig 558, a Mewbourne location, Loco Hills, New Mexico. During casing running operations, a joint of 7 inch casing came through the V-door and struck Duggins left hand, resulting in a laceration.  Operations was suspended and first aid was initiated on location. Duggin was transported to Lovington Regional Hospital where the facility determined it was not equipped to treat the injury. Duggin was care flighted to University Medical Center in Lubbock, Texas and admitted as an inpatient. Treating physicians confirmed no fractures or broken bones.
